profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at Sam's Club
profile.summary: I am a seasoned software engineer with a wealth of knowledge and experience architecting and developing scalable, message-driven systems using a variety of technologies. I'm also well-versed in Kubernetes usage and administration. Most of my current work focuses exclusively on enabling application teams to provision, configure, and leverage Kubernetes to solve business problems.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Part of the enterprise architecture team, responsible for defining Sam's Club's devops and continuous delivery strategy leveraging Kubernetes.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer - Walmart Cloud Native Platform
positions.description:
Part of the core architecture team responsible for creating the Walmart Cloud Native Platform, whose goal is to create a ubiquitous developer experience across multiple cloud providers and on-premise edge environments, leveraging Kubernetes to create a platform as a service.

Designed and prototyped the core Kubernetes cluster provisioning orchestration used by Walmart across Azure and VMWare providers.

Part of a team of engineers that designed and implemented an opinionated GitOps approach to continuous delivery at scale using Kubernetes as the application platform.

Created a suite of cli integrations in golang to manage the complexity of authenticating to and discovering multiple Kubernetes clusters.

Contributed to various Kubernetes operators designed to manage the cataloging and lifecycle of a Kubernetes cluster.

Performed technical interviews for potential candidates for employment.

positions.title: Systems Analyst
positions.description:
Designed   and   led   development   of   the   next   generation   store   tax   systems   based   on   a   microservices architecture.

Created   and   enforced   a   standard   workflow   for   introducing   any   change   to   tax   software   into   a production   environment.   Part   of   this   workflow   included   authoring   a   pipeline   that   lets   a   developer easily   deploy   an   application   to   production   with   zero   downtime.   The   OneOps   API   was   instrumented directly   to   allow   canary-style   deployments   and   rollbacks.   Various   monitoring   strategies   were employed   to   ensure   SLAs   were   met   and   outages   minimized.

Provided   mid-level   architectures   for   systems   to   finance   area   development   teams   using   Enterprise Integration   Patterns.

Mentored   finance   area   teams   and   vendors   regarding   software   development   and   testing   best practices.

Performed   technical   interviews   for   potential   candidates   for   employment.
